notes:
选线更简洁，减少意外断流。

- 测速失败和后台出口探测超时不再打断已有连接，也不再清空 DNS 缓存。
- 默认开启统一延迟；测速失败只重试一次，分组测速等待最长 40 秒。
- 切换线路只清理该分组的旧连接，保留其他分组和已使用新线路的连接。

- 移除线路页“自动选择已开启”模块和独立开关，直接在分组内选择具体节点或自动组。
- 保留按订阅记住的手动选择；点击自动组当前节点仍可选择该具体节点，AI 等独立分组继续使用各自的选择。
- 测速进度直接显示在按钮和节点上，移除重复的开始提示。
- 断开连接或使用直连模式时，托盘不再显示无效的“连接最佳节点”入口。
- 托盘“最近线路”仅在连接可切换时显示；重复点选当前线路不重切，切换失败不再提示成功。
- Android 通知中的“切换线路”直接打开线路页，由你选择所需线路。
notesEn:
Simpler route selection, fewer unintended interruptions.

- Failed latency tests and background egress probes no longer close existing connections or flush the DNS cache.
- Unified delay is enabled by default. Failed group tests retry once, with a 40-second overall wait limit.
- Switching a route retires old connections in that group while preserving other groups and connections already using the new route.

- Removed the automatic-selection status panel and its separate switch. Choose an individual node or an automatic group directly from the group list.
- Manual selections are still remembered per subscription. Tapping the current node inside an automatic group can still select that individual node; independent groups such as AI keep their own choices.
- Speed-test progress remains visible on the button and nodes, with the redundant start notification removed.
- The tray no longer offers “Connect best node” while disconnected or in direct mode.
- Recent-node tray shortcuts appear only when the connection can switch routes. Selecting the current node does nothing, and failed switches no longer report success.
- “Switch node” in the Android notification opens the route list so you can choose the node you want.
